title: What Is Climax in Literature? — High School Toolkit
skills: identify the turning point of a story
analyze how conflict and tension culminate at the climax
explain how the climax influences falling action and resolution
alignment_note: Introduces climax as the central turning point of a narrative where conflict and tension reach their highest intensity. Supports plot analysis, sequencing, interpretation of narrative structure, and understanding of how the climax shapes subsequent falling action and resolution across high school English courses.
